about: Sites of documents side by side (0.1.0 plan ST7), run by `omui-devtools bench sites`: one corpus — the minimal documents (modules/projects/oweb/templates/docs: seven pages in two languages and the generated reference) — built by each side at its pin, as its own starter sets a site up (its default theme; its own search where it has one). Measured from outside: the build's wall time (`rounds` builds, the output removed before each; the median), what is written (every file as stored and as a static host sends it: mlibs.delivery), and each route visited in headless Chromium, cold, on `network` (megabits a second / round trip in ms) with the processor slowed `cpu` times — Lighthouse's mobile profile — in a `viewport` of a phone: the bytes transferred by kind, the requests, the first and the largest contentful paint, the time long tasks blocked (each task's time over 50 ms, over the visit). Then the same route with scripts off: whether the words a reader came for (`says`) are in the page. What an agent that only fetches finds is said as facts: a route's Markdown, llms.txt, a table of the routes, the search's index as data. Each side's project is beside this file (its configuration only); the harness puts the corpus in, in the form the side reads (`form`: `pages` as they are, `routes` with a title in front matter and links between pages as routes — Starlight follows no link to a .md file).
